# Update pricing, invite expiry, and display names

## Summary

Implement the three current product asks captured in the latest brain dump. The Team plan price remains unchanged at 40; the proposed increase to 45 is cancelled.

## Requirements

1. Set the Pro plan price to 15 (currently 12).
2. Add `expires_at` to `app.invites.Invite`. New invites must expire 14 days after `created_at`.
3. Fix `app.display.display_name` so Arabic names are not blanked or corrupted. Preserve the existing user-facing shortening behavior as safely as possible.
4. Keep the Team plan price at 40. Do not implement the cancelled increase to 45.

## Acceptance criteria

- `price("pro")` returns 15.
- `price("team")` returns 40.
- A newly created invite exposes `expires_at`, and it is exactly 14 days after its creation timestamp.
- An Arabic name passed to `display_name` returns visible Arabic text rather than an empty string; existing ASCII name behavior continues to work.

## Source decisions

- "pro plan price goes 12 -> 15"
- "invites expire after 7 days" corrected by the later message to "make it 14 days not 7"
- "team plan to 45" cancelled by the later message: "scrap 3, Omar changed his mind, team stays at 40"
- "display_name blanks out Arabic names, needs fixing"

Label: ready-for-agent
